messages:
maria: Heads up — proposing a go/no-go sync for the next cut: Tue Apr 12 10:00 PT. Need roster + quick agenda. Who can join? :wave:
kevin: I can make that. 30 or 45 minutes?
maria: 30 should be fine. Main asks: canary owners, DB migration plan, rollback checklist, infra smoke. Draft agenda below.
liz: I can take canary ownership.
maria: ```
Agenda (30m):
1) Quick rollcall & owner confirmations (5m)
2) Migration & rollback checklist sign-off (8m)
3) Canary plan + traffic ramp (8m)
4) Smoke/runbook + monitoring pointers (5m)
5) Any blockers / go/no-go vote (4m)
```
dario: I may be on PTO that day — happy to prep canary before I leave. If I'm out, @kevin can step in.
kevin: Yep I can step in for dario if needed.
sam: Oncall good for 10:00 PT. I'll have the alert playbook ready: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/release
deploy-bot: Created calendar event "go-no-go-sync" Apr 12 10:00 PT. Invites sent to: maria, kevin, liz, dario, sam.
maria: Pls ack here and add any last-minute items. Also we need someone to own the DB migration dry run — tagging infra/DB folks.
liz: I will own the migration dry run and run it Wed prior (Apr 11). I'll push results to the release doc.
dario: Quick release checklist I suggest we confirm before the call:
- smoke test scripts pass on staging
- canary metrics dashboard pinned
- rollback tag & playbook verified
- migration dry-run completed
- alert thresholds reviewed
maria: Great checklist, thanks. kevin — can you confirm the rollback tag naming convention?
kevin: Using `release/v{semver}-pre` for the canary tag, and `release/v{semver}-rollback` prepared. Will add to the doc. :+1:
liz: Question: do we want a load test prior to the cut or rely on the light QA ramp?
maria: Light QA ramp should be sufficient unless we see perf regressions in the dry run. If so, we delay canary start by 1 hour.
sam: Smoke script is at `scripts/release_smoke.sh` and here is the metrics dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/release-canary
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled for 24h and 1h before the event.
maria: Final ask — please update the release doc with owners and any risks by Friday EOD. I'll close the roster then and send the final invite with dial-in + zoom. Thanks all. :rocket:
